decisions.reason: As an upgraded version of an already accepted trommel screen with clear continuity from the BASIC 518, it fits the firm's existing screening know-how and service base, so management would expect further learning and refinement rather than withdrawal.

The AK flail shredders are close to the firm's core mobile waste-processing competence and the 2019 Stage V update across the series signals active adaptation and sufficient internal knowledge to keep the line commercially viable.

The mobile high-speed grinder is strongly related to the firm's established mobile comminution business and its move from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 suggests the firm was still building market understanding rather than preparing an exit.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are highly complementary to the firm's core shredding and plant business, and the CERON generation was presented as setting standards with concrete application evidence, making continuation the likely choice.
